sites_reviewed: NUS The Deck / Yusof Ishak House

scope.method: Rebound the prior exact-licence sample to the current Refresh130-installed workbook and rechecked the cited official site/operator pages on 2026-10-19. No materially changed closure or public-access evidence was found. Records remain keyed by exact SFA licence; no changes inferred from address alone.
rules: No removal based solely on business type, campus/industrial address or a shared site closure.
Do not propagate Jurong Port restrictions to 29A Jurong Port Road Food Centre without boundary evidence.
Do not confuse Changi T1 public-area staff canteen with separately restricted T3 B2 dining area.
Treat temporary and site-specific access notices as scoped to named facility, dates and hours.

sources.observed: Current official page lists Amber West, Crema West and other retail/F&B outlets at ITE College West; the associated campus has a Customer & Visitor Centre and programmes for external secondary-school visitors.
sources.assessment: Supports exact ITE outlet records and no evidence of permanent closure. Does not explicitly state unrestricted general-public entry to every outlet; insufficient by itself to remove or certify unrestricted access.

sources.observed: NTU describes alumni and their relatives returning to campus to eat at Canteen 1 or Canteen 2. NTU visitor/campus shuttle information is current.
sources.assessment: Positive evidence that NTU campus dining is not categorically restricted to enrolled students/staff. Keep these Canteen 2 records.

sources.observed: Official NTU campus guide describes food outlets as serving the university community and campus visitors and locates Canteen 2.
sources.assessment: Older but specific source; corroborates visitor use. Newer alumni source supplements it.

sources.observed: Official admissions page describes NUS as an open campus with self-guided tours.
sources.assessment: Supports public campus visits. The reviewed temporary UTown food-court restrictions do not match The Deck or Yusof Ishak House; do not generalize them to these outlets.

sources.observed: Official visitor notice describes temporary UTown food-court access restrictions on specific dates in Aug/Sept-Oct 2026 and campus visits accompanied by a licensed tour guide.
sources.assessment: Scoped to UTown food courts and specified dates; no match to these workbook rows. No removal.

sources.observed: Current SIT campus page identifies Campus Court food-court operations including weekends/public holidays and describes the Punggol campus as providing public-access spaces and amenities.
sources.assessment: Positive evidence against blanket exclusion of Campus Court. Keep.

sources.observed: Official airport publication lists Terminal 1 Staff Canteen in Basement 1 and identifies its location as the Public Area.
sources.assessment: T1 address does not prove restricted access; public-area designation supports retaining these records.

sources.observed: CAAS specifically identifies a dining area at Terminal 3 Basement 2 as airport-staff-only.
sources.assessment: Different location from the workbook T1 Upper Basement Canteen; not evidence to remove T1 rows.

sources.observed: Official page confirms the CSC address and operating schedule, but does not provide a general public entry policy or describe the workbook outlet as staff-only.
sources.assessment: Access unresolved for the single takeaway licence. Do not remove absent direct restriction evidence.

sources.observed: Workbook identifies one licensed food vending machine on a college campus; this pass found no current official statement proving that its location is behind access control or public-facing.
sources.assessment: Insufficient to remove or certify public accessibility. Keep unresolved.

sources.observed: JTC official F&B listing describes eating houses/food courts for industrialists and the community. A specific JTC tenancy application guide exists for hawker stalls at 29A Jurong Port Road Food Centre. The food-centre name alone does not prove the records are inside Jurong Port security perimeter.
sources.assessment: Do not apply Jurong Port pass restrictions by name alone; exact food-centre boundary/public entry not proven restricted. Keep pending stronger evidence.

sources.observed: Official FAQ states port users need a sponsored JP Pass and port entry requires pass scanning and biometric verification.
sources.assessment: Applies to Jurong Port itself. Does not establish that 29A Jurong Port Road Food Centre is inside the restricted premises; no removals.

sources.observed: Rechecked 2026-10-19. Page footer says last updated 15 Oct 2026. Retail/F&B table lists Amber West (Fine Dining Restaurant), telephone 6431 0178, Block 2 Level 4, Mon–Fri lunch and dinner hours; Crema West (Cafe), telephone 6431 0179, Block 3 Level 4, Mon–Fri hours. The page describes student-related, general and retail facilities but gives no explicit unrestricted public-entry rule.
sources.assessment: Current positive existence evidence for the matching ITE licensees SW10407A000 (Amber West) and SW13X34P000 (Crema; directory calls it Crema West), not for SW10415A000 (Chez West). Keep access unresolved; no removal recommendation.

summary.reason: Rechecking against the current workbook found all 23 exact SFA licence records still present with matching outlet names and addresses; the official evidence cited in Refresh130 remains scoped to the same facilities. No strong exact-branch permanent closure or access restriction was found, so no removal is recommended.

limitations: Targeted 23-record institutional/workplace sample only; not a nationwide closure or access audit. Three records remain unresolved for unrestricted public access (ITE College West, CSC, LASALLE) and five Jurong Port Road Food Centre records remain unresolved pending evidence that the food centre is within a controlled-access boundary. No workbook edits, paid services, Mapbox requests, or external writes.
